final: WITH hand_counts AS (SELECT COALESCE(p.bats, '') AS batting_hand, COUNT(*) AS award_count FROM player_award AS a JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = a.player_id GROUP BY COALESCE(p.bats, '')), shares AS (SELECT batting_hand, award_count, award_count * 1.0 / SUM(award_count) OVER () AS share FROM hand_counts) SELECT batting_hand, award_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS above_average FROM shares WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM shares) ORDER BY batting_hand
